action.message: A journal entry can belong to only one entity, and CA01 (CAD) and US01 (USD) report in different currencies, so I can't post a single $1,200 accrual across both. How should the amount be split? For example, give a separate amount for CA01 in CAD and for US01 in USD. Or should the full $1,200 go to just one of them? Once you confirm, I'll propose a separate entry for each entity for June 2026. Each entry would debit 6300 Office Supplies (ADM) and credit 2100 Accrued Liabilities.
